provenance.encodes: Indigo Book T6 (Required Abbreviations for Treaty Sources): Senate Executive Documents (1778-1980), S. Exec. Doc. No. <letter|no.>, <n>th Cong.

positive.text: See S. Exec. Doc. No. C, 95th Cong. (1978).
The court relied on S. Exec. Doc. No. 12, 81st Cong. (1949) in reaching its holding.
Under S. Exec. Doc. No. L, the claim fails.

note: Indigo T6 lists Senate Executive Documents as a treaty source; the authority key leaves out the Congress because a lettered document is often cited without it.
